steps.title: Sketch the plate
steps.command: 3D Model tab > Sketch panel > Start 2D Sketch
actions: File > New > Standard (mm).ipt to start a new part.
Start 2D Sketch on the XZ Plane (the top).
Rectangle (Two Point Center) on the origin.
Add the dimensions with Dimension (Sketch tab > Constrain panel): 100 by 60. Click Finish Sketch.

steps.title: Extrude the plate
actions: Click Extrude. Distance A: 10 mm. Click OK.

steps.title: Sketch the hole centres
steps.command: 3D Model tab > Sketch panel > Start 2D Sketch
actions: Start 2D Sketch on the top face.
Draw a 76 by 36 rectangle on the centre and make it Construction (Format panel).
Point: put a point on each corner of the construction rectangle. Click Finish Sketch.

steps.title: Countersink the four holes
actions: Click Hole. Inventor picks all four sketch points.
Type: Countersink. Diameter 6.6 mm, countersink diameter 13 mm, angle 90 degrees. Through All. Click OK.

steps.title: Bore the 40 mm hole
actions: Click Hole and place it on the centre of the plate. Simple Hole. Diameter 40 mm. Through All. Click OK.

steps.title: Chamfer the bore
actions: Click Chamfer. Distance 1 mm (1 x 45 degrees). Pick the top edge of the 40 mm bore. Click OK.
